entry.en: Your passport must be valid at least 6 months after arrival in Palau and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Su pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses desde la llegada a Palaos y al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Palau and at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: You can visit Palau for up to 30 days without a pre-arranged visa.
entry.es: Puede visitar Palaos hasta 30 días sin visado previo.
entry.quote: You can visit Palau for up to 30 days without a pre-arranged visa.

entry.en: Border officials issue a 30-day tourist visa on arrival, and you may need to show proof of onward or return travel.
entry.es: Las autoridades fronterizas emiten un visado turístico de 30 días a la llegada y puede que deba mostrar un billete de continuación o regreso.
entry.quote: Border officials will issue a 30-day tourist visa on arrival. You may need to show proof of onward or return travel.

entry.en: You must sign the Palau Pledge, which is stamped in your passport on arrival.
entry.es: Debe firmar el Compromiso de Palaos (Palau Pledge), que se sella en su pasaporte a la llegada.
entry.quote: You must sign the Palau Pledge which is stamped in your passport on arrival.

entry.en: You must complete the Palau entry form within 72 hours of your arrival.
entry.es: Debe completar el formulario de entrada de Palaos en las 72 horas posteriores a su llegada.
entry.quote: You must also complete the Palau entry form within 72 hours of your arrival.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more.
entry.es: Debe declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses o más.
entry.quote: cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 US dollars or more.

safety.en: Crime levels are low, and theft of unattended items is more likely than confrontational crime.
safety.es: Los niveles de delincuencia son bajos y es más probable el robo de objetos sin vigilancia que un delito con enfrentamiento.
safety.quote: Crime levels are low, and you’re more likely to experience theft of unattended items than confrontational crime.

safety.en: There has been an increase in credit card fraud, which may include skimming devices.
safety.es: Ha aumentado el fraude con tarjetas de crédito, que puede incluir dispositivos de clonación.
safety.quote: There has been an increase in credit card fraud. This may include credit card skimming devices or other types of data theft.

safety.en: There are unexploded World War 2 bombs and weapons in Palau, with higher risk on Peleliu and Angaur.
safety.es: Hay bombas y armas sin explotar de la Segunda Guerra Mundial en Palaos, con mayor riesgo en Peleliu y Angaur.
safety.quote: There are unexploded World War 2 bombs and weapons in Palau. There is a higher risk on the islands of Peleliu and Angaur

safety.en: It is illegal to use reef-toxic sunscreen in Palau.
safety.es: Es ilegal usar protector solar tóxico para los arrecifes en Palaos.
safety.quote: It’s illegal to use reef-toxic sunscreen in Palau.

safety.en: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public in Palau, except on licensed premises.
safety.es: Es ilegal beber alcohol en público en Palaos, salvo en locales con licencia.
safety.quote: It is illegal to drink alcohol in public, except on licensed premises.

safety.en: Roads are unlit and rural areas have limited signage, so avoid driving after dark.
safety.es: Las carreteras no tienen alumbrado y las zonas rurales tienen poca señalización, por lo que se aconseja evitar conducir de noche.
safety.quote: Avoid driving after dark, as roads are unlit and you could hit people or livestock.

health.en: The only national hospital is Belau National Hospital in Koror, which has a hyperbaric chamber.
health.es: El único hospital nacional es el Belau National Hospital en Koror, que cuenta con cámara hiperbárica.
health.quote: The only national hospital is Belau National Hospital in Koror, which is less than 2 hours from most locations. The hospital has a hyperbaric chamber

health.en: Doctors and medical centres often expect immediate cash payment.
health.es: Los médicos y centros médicos suelen esperar el pago inmediato en efectivo.
health.quote: Doctors and medical centres often expect immediate cash payment.

health.en: Emergency or serious treatment is limited and may require medical evacuation.
health.es: El tratamiento de urgencia o de enfermedades graves es limitado y puede requerir evacuación médica.
health.quote: Emergency treatment or treatment for serious conditions is limited so may require medical evacuation.

health.en: According to the CDC, tap water in Palau is generally safe to drink, per Wikivoyage.
health.es: Según el CDC, citado por Wikivoyage, el agua del grifo en Palaos es en general segura para beber.
health.quote: According to the CDC, tap water in Palau is generally safe to drink.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police in Palau is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía en Palaos es el 911.

help.en: Urgent help for a friend or relative abroad is available from FCDO in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours.
help.es: Para ayuda urgente por un amigo o familiar en el extranjero, el FCDO en Londres atiende en el 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says there is only one airport, Roman Tmetuchl International Airport (ROR) at Airai on Babeldaob.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que solo hay un aeropuerto, el Aeropuerto Internacional Roman Tmetuchl (ROR) en Airai, Babeldaob.
getting_in.quote: There is only one airport, Airai (ROR IATA), or officially Roman Tmetuchl International Airport, on Babeldaob.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage lists scheduled direct flights from Brisbane, Guam, Manila, Nauru, Taipei and Tokyo.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage menciona vuelos directos regulares desde Brisbane, Guam, Manila, Nauru, Taipéi y Tokio.
getting_in.quote: This airport is served by scheduled direct flights from Brisbane (on Saturdays only), Guam, Manila, Nauru, Taipei and Tokyo, and charter flights from Hong Kong.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says no taxis were waiting at the airport as of 2023, so transfers need to be organised in advance.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que en 2023 no había taxis esperando en el aeropuerto, por lo que hay que organizar el traslado con antelación.
getting_in.quote: As of 2023, there were no taxis waiting for incoming passengers at the airport, so you will need to organize your transfer to your hotel in advance (approx US$30).

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says arriving by sea is only recommended for experienced mariners.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que llegar por mar solo se recomienda a navegantes experimentados.
getting_in.quote: Possible but only recommended for experienced mariners.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says there are many local taxis.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que hay muchos taxis locales.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says traffic drives on the right, though both left- and right-hand drive cars are present.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que se circula por la derecha, aunque hay coches con volante a la izquierda y a la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Palau features both left- and right-hand drive cars, which can cause some confusion; traffic drives on the right.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says the national speed limit is 25 mph (40 km/h), even on rural roads.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que el límite nacional de velocidad es de 25 mph (40 km/h), incluso en carreteras rurales.
getting_around.quote: The national speed limit is 25 mph (40 km/h), even on rural roads.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says motorcycle rentals are relatively cheap.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que el alquiler de motos es relativamente barato.
getting_around.quote: Renting a motorcycle is also a good idea. Palau is small enough to ride around on one, and rentals are relatively cheap.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says a boat ride of an hour or more to dive spots costs around US$150 for a two-tank dive.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que una salida en barco de una hora o más a los puntos de buceo cuesta unos 150 USD por una inmersión de dos tanques.
getting_around.quote: Any other diving will be from a boat, after an hour or more ride which will cost around US$150 for a two-tank dive.

money.en: Palau uses the US dollar as its currency.
money.es: Palaos usa el dólar estadounidense como moneda.
money.quote: Palau uses the U.S. dollar as its currency

money.en: Wikivoyage says prices are comparatively high, with a low-end daily budget around $100.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que los precios son comparativamente altos, con un presupuesto diario mínimo de unos 100 dólares.
money.quote: prices are comparatively high, and even a low-end daily budget would be around $100/day.

money.en: Wikivoyage says tipping is not mandatory but a customary 10-15% is generally expected.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que la propina no es obligatoria, pero se espera en general una propina habitual del 10-15%.
money.quote: It's not mandatory, but it is generally expected that you pay a customary 10–15% tip.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says Palauans are known for their hospitality and easily give respect to foreign visitors.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que los palauanos son conocidos por su hospitalidad y respetan fácilmente a los visitantes extranjeros.
etiquette.quote: Palauans have been known throughout history for their hospitality.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says rude remarks or prejudice against the local culture is not taken kindly.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que los comentarios groseros o los prejuicios contra la cultura local no son bien recibidos.
etiquette.quote: rude remarks or any form of prejudice against the local culture is not taken kindly.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says visitors should not disrespect the culture, violate historic areas, pollute, or harm the ocean.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que los visitantes no deben faltar al respeto a la cultura, violar zonas históricas, contaminar ni dañar el océano.
etiquette.quote: As long as you do not disrespect the culture, violate historic areas, pollute, or harm the ocean in any way

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says free Wi-Fi is common around Koror.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que el wifi gratuito es habitual en los alrededores de Koror.
connectivity.quote: You can use free Wi-Fi, which is common around Koror

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says SIM cards from the 2 carriers, PNCC and Globus, can be bought at mini marts, shopping centers or official stores.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que las SIM de los 2 operadores, PNCC y Globus, se compran en minimercados, centros comerciales o tiendas oficiales.
connectivity.quote: get a SIM card from one of the 2 carriers (PNCC, Globus). You can buy a SIM card from mini marts, shopping centers or the carriers' official stores.
